title: Sign Regulations
previewText: In the Special Downtown Brooklyn District, except as modified by the provisions of Section 101-131 (Permitted projection), the regulations of Section 32-60, inclusive, pertaining to signs, shall apply. Further regulations for the Fulton Mall Subdistrict and the Atlantic Avenue Subdistrict are set forth in Section 101-60, inclusive, and Section 101-70, inclusive.
